name: Wolves in the Night
source:
Join our protagonist, William, a human of the age 19 as he finds himself stumbling onto something that will change his life. With his beliefs turning upside down, our protagonist finds himself having to face dangerous challanges, finding deep secrets about his family's past, along with the creation of a lot of unexpected friendships. How will William manage to deal with everything though? We will see as the story progresses.
